canonical_storage.ledger: GitHub versioned immutable content-addressed state objects
canonical_storage.write_mode: write-through under one retained repository writer lease
canonical_storage.lease_refresh: refresh expiry on every checkpoint/pending-write commit
canonical_storage.finalization: publisher atomically writes final evidence/run-state and releases lease
canonical_storage.fetch_back: exact commit ref, canonical JSON and SHA-256 verification

recovery.crash_recovery: resume from latest fetch-back-verified checkpoint for same run_id
recovery.duplicate_put: idempotent by thread_id/checkpoint_ns/checkpoint_id and canonical digest
recovery.expired_lease: reacquire only after canonical expiry is verified

destructive_operations.reason: canonical public Git history is append-only; no destructive retention rewrite without separate owner approval

wrong mission, oversized payload, pickle/object, secret/raw-body rejection tests
